name: Six Senses Ninh Van Bay
positioning: Beach resort on a bay facing the East Vietnam Sea near Nha Trang, reached by water, with villas on the beach, over the water, among the rocks and on the hillside
best_for: Travelers who want a secluded beach villa with ocean views
Nature lovers drawn to rock formations, mountains and a sheltered bay

facts.text: The resort sits on a bay looking out to the East Vietnam Sea and is reached by water.
The setting has rock formations, a white sand beach and a backdrop of towering mountains.
The resort is near Nha Trang.
Villas are directly on the beach, over the water, between the rocks or on a mountain slope.
All villas offer panoramic ocean views.
Villas have a garden terrace or sundeck.
The calm sheltered bay offers land and water activities.
A troop of rare endangered monkeys lives in the hills behind the resort.

highlights.text: Villas sit directly on the beach, over the water, between the rocks or on a mountain slope, all with panoramic ocean views.
Rock formations, a white sand beach and towering mountains frame the bay.
A troop of rare endangered monkeys lives in the hills behind the resort.

considerations.text: The resort faces the East Vietnam Sea on a bay and is reached by water.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
